Evidence: Economic stability, Political survival, Historical legacy. #Aletheia #USPol

President Trump is evaluating his presidency through the lens of historical economic failure, specifically the Great Depression, while managing a prolonged war in Iran.

Trump uses the Hoover comparison as a pretext to justify a policy shift, projecting his fear of personal failure onto the national economic narrative.

The Trajectory: The Path of Revelation.
